description: This file provides configuration helpers for authentication, including environment variable parsing, validation of secrets and salts, tenant resolution strategies, and access control mechanisms. It exports functions to retrieve and validate secrets, salts, and tenant configurations, facilitating secure and flexible authentication setup.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes input values by converting undefined or null to empty string and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isUrlSafeShortBase64
methods.description: Validates if a string is URL-safe base64 without padding, typically 20-44 characters long, and contains only URL-safe characters.

methods.name: getTenantSaltConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the tenant salt from environment variables, normalizing and checking its format.

methods.name: getJwtSecretConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and assesses the JWT secret from environment variables, checking for presence and strength.

methods.name: getPasswordSaltConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the password salt from environment variables, checking for placeholder values and length.

methods.name: tenantFromHost
methods.description: Extracts the tenant identifier from a host header by taking the left-most label.

methods.name: getTenantConfig
methods.description: Provides tenant resolution and allowlist/mapping validation based on environment variables and request data.
